later_created_issues.body:
Independent adversarial review found a minor provenance overstatement in the round42 Theisen source dossier (no accepted record is affected).

Stable finding key: `CMMMech.theisen.source-version-date`.

Affected input: `research/sources/round42-theisen-sludge/20261012T015742Z-source-investigation.md`, version-date paragraph. It interprets March 2016 as accepted-manuscript availability. The inspected Wiley record only labels 23 March 2016 “First published”; Crossref gives `published-online` 25 April 2016, and Oxford displays the June issue date. These receipts do not establish a manuscript-version mapping.

Correction required: preserve each provider's literal date label and leave the relationship between manuscript versions unresolved. Verify the corrected paragraph against retained acquisition receipts and obtain a successor independent disposition before publication. Keep the primary-paper and supplementary-access deferral intact.

Initial independent review: `/private/tmp/cmm-round42-theisen-independent-initial-20261012T015921Z.md` and its JSON companion. The final disposition and published dossier will be linked from the PR.

later_created_issues.body:
The round42 source investigation identified a distinct secondary-resource candidate, Theisen sludge from former copper-shale smelting, but did not admit a record because complete primary methods, original graphics and relevant supplementary evidence were not available for inspection.

Primary target: Klink et al. (2016), *Journal of Applied Microbiology* 120(6):1520–1530, DOI [10.1111/jam.13142](https://doi.org/10.1111/jam.13142), PMID 27005888. Publisher, Crossref and UFZ metadata agree on the study identity. Indexed author text and abstracts are discovery evidence only.

The investigation is staged at `research/sources/round42-theisen-sludge/20261012T015742Z-source-investigation.md` with a JSON acquisition/search manifest; a published link will be added after merge. Direct Wiley/ResearchGate requests and the original supplementary link failed; UFZ's shareable link reached a verification page; current Oxford article/supplement links exposed the purchase/abstract view. These failures are access limits, not evidence that the study lacks methods or supplements.

Acceptance criteria:

- Acquire the complete paper and relevant original Tables 1–2, Figures 1–3 and supplementary Table S1/Figures S1–S9 through a legitimate route; retain URL, version, acquisition date and hashes.
- Verify feed provenance, culture membership and the reported strain accession; distinguish viable/inactivated controls, pretreatment, loading, pH, temperature, sampling, replication and dissolved/solid accounting.
- Reconcile quantities and study-version differences against originals. Do not import abstract percentages/fold changes or infer isolated-product recovery or industrial deployment.
- Compare the 2015 report (10.4028/www.scientific.net/AMR.1130.321) and 2016 poster for experiment overlap. Keep downstream speciation/separation studies distinct.
- Repeat hidden/ignored-inclusive material/study deduplication, including newly available referenced raw directories. Then either curate a scoped `secondary_resource` record with canonical history and independent review, or record why deferral remains appropriate.

This is a source-access/review follow-up, not a defect in an accepted record. Nine referenced raw directories were unavailable in this bounded search; no machine-wide absence or source exhaustion is claimed.
later_created_issues.title: Acquire complete Theisen sludge primary evidence before record admission
